background.value: Evenly lit background (white or light grey accepted)

validity.value: Must show face as it looks today (taken recently)

glasses_policy.value: Glasses are not to be worn; exception for documented medical reasons with doctor's note

headwear_policy.value: Headgear is not to be worn; religious or medical headwear permitted if worn regularly and does not cover facial features or distort face shape

ears_visibility.value: Both ears must be entirely visible

face_visibility.value: Both eyes, both eyebrows and both ears must be entirely visible; face photographed from front; eyes directed at camera

clothing_restriction.value: Scarves, bags and outerwear must be removed before being photographed
